findings.explanation: HOL4 allows the two namespaces to have different value types. For example, it can compare a numeric binding of 0 with a Boolean binding of true at the same key, using a relation that says the Boolean is true exactly when the number is zero. Lean uses V for both namespaces and both value arguments of R, so this application is ill-typed.
findings.repair:
def nsSub_compute {M : Type u} {N : Type v} {V : Type w} {V' : Type _} :
    List M → (Ident M N → V → V' → Prop) → Namespace M N V → Namespace M N V' → Prop
  | path, R, .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k v1 v2 => R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alist_rel_restr_mem e1M e2M (fun k v1 _ v2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R v1 v2)
      (MAP FST e1M)
termination_by _ _ e1 _ => sizeOf e1
decreasing_by
  rename_i h
  have := sizeOf_ALOOKUP e1M _ _ h
  simp
  omega
